scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && bun run tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy-plugin: rm -rf .opencode/plugins/agent-manager && mkdir -p .opencode/plugins/agent-manager && rm -f .opencode/plugins/agent-manager.js && printf 'export { server } from "./agent-manager/index.js";\n' > .opencode/plugins/agent-manager.js && cp -R dist/. .opencode/plugins/agent-manager/
scripts.install-plugin: bun run build && bun run deploy-plugin
scripts.ci: bun run build && bun run deploy-plugin && bun run smoke
scripts.audit:ci: bunx npm audit && bun test test/dependency-audit.test.ts
